condition.help: Potential seepage face. Assign it to a boundary that may discharge water but whose wet extent is not known in advance, such as the downstream slope of a dam without a drain. The solver decides node by node: where pressure would rise above atmospheric the node is held at zero pressure head and allowed to discharge, and where flow would enter the domain the node reverts to zero flux. The exit point of the free surface is therefore part of the solution, not an input. Takes no value. Do NOT combine it with a prescribed head on the same nodes. Leave a boundary WITHOUT any condition to obtain plain zero flux.
